about: What NPC partners say. NPC partners are the crew mates that the game runs when a seat has no player. This file is the only source of their words: the server never writes partner text itself. It picks one line from here and fills in the {placeholders}. The rules for these lines are in docs/story/NPC-PARTNERS.md, section 9.
voice: A cheerful salvage crew. Short, warm, a little nautical. Titles only, no personal names. Players are captains in this game, so a partner says 'Captain' to whoever gave the order, but not in every line. A line may repeat what its own card shows. It never names another card, a deduction or a suspect, and it never gives advice.
pick_rule: Take lines[variant][salt mod the number of lines in that list]. Each event names its salt in salt_is. There are no random numbers, so the same crew and the same orders always give the same words.

placeholders.minutes: A whole number of case minutes. In order_accepted it is the length of the errand (10 for a trip, 5 for a pin). In cannot_do_it it is the wait until the partner is free (busy) or until an order would arrive inside the window of a timed route (locked_window).
placeholders.light: The name of a light, with its article, for example: the Harbor Light.

order_accepted.used_when: A partner takes an order. Said at the minute the order was given. The variant is the order kind, and search and fetch both use go.
order_accepted.salt_is: the order number (the crew's count of accepted orders, starting at 1)

go: On it, Captain! Back in about {minutes} minutes.
Aye aye! Off I go. Back in about {minutes} minutes.
pin: Off to the board with this one. About {minutes} minutes.
man_light: I'll take {light}. Keeping her lit till you say.
wait: Standing by. Shout when you need me.

arrived.used_when: A partner on a search or a fetch reaches the place. Said at arrive_at, 4 minutes after the order.

any: Made landfall. Having a good look around.

found_card.used_when: A search or a fetch ends and the partner has the card in its satchel. Said at ready_at. The variant is the card id.

C1: Got the reward notice. It's about a light where none stands.
C2: Wrecks only on fog nights. I've got it written down.
C3: The key tag has a stamp: an anchor with an open eye.
C4: Found the crates. Every lid is stamped with a seal.
C5: Got the yard manifest. Twelve lenses on it.
C6: Got the owner's post. A payment slip for every wreck.
C7: Got hold of the coastguard's night log.
C8: A torn page, found in the ruin. Damp, but readable.

found_nothing.used_when: A search ends at a place that holds no card, or whose card is not a lead yet. Said at ready_at.

any: Nothing here but gulls and rope, Captain.

pinned_card.used_when: A pin order ends and the card is on the board. Said at ready_at. The variant is the card id.

C1: Reward notice is up on the board.
C2: Fog nights only. It's on the board now.
C3: The key tag seal is pinned, anchor and open eye.
C4: Same seal on the crates. Pinning it.
C5: Manifest pinned. Twelve lenses on the list.
C6: Owner's post is pinned. Smells of ink.
C8: Torn page pinned. Handle with care.

cannot_do_it.used_when: An order is refused. No order is created, so no minutes pass and no coins are taken. The variant is the line group of the reason.
cannot_do_it.salt_is: the crew's count of accepted orders so far

wrong_kit: That one's not for me, Captain. I don't carry what it needs.
no_coins: That costs {price} coins, and the purse is short.
locked_window: Shut when I'd get there, Captain. Ask me again in about {minutes} minutes.
busy: Still on my last job. Free again in about {minutes} minutes.
already_have: I already have that one, Captain.
not_ready: Can't do that one yet, Captain. Not the right moment.

manning_light.used_when: A partner reaches its light and goes on duty. Said at ready_at of the man_light order.

any: At {light}. She's lit and holding steady.

beam_locked.used_when: A player locks the beam of the light this partner holds. Said by that partner at the minute the lock is accepted.

any: Beam's locked on the blinking light. Hold steady!

case_solved.used_when: The crew solves the case. Said by every partner. The line is chosen by seat number.

any: The coast is lit again! Best crew on the Isles, Captain.
Lamps up and fog down. What a night, Captain!

takeover.used_when: A friend takes the seat. Said once by the partner who leaves.

any: The seat's yours now. Mind the satchel, Captain.
